name: Hanoi to Ha Long
summary: The bay is a half-day transfer from Hanoi. A through ticket to a boat is smoother than arriving in the city and negotiating at the harbor.

modes.note: The usual choice. Traffic on the way out of Hanoi decides the hour.
Leaves before dawn and returns at night. Check how many hours are actually on the water.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Ha Long — car, bus, and day boats
seoDescription: How long Hanoi to Ha Long takes by road, and how to judge a day-tour boat.

faqs.q: Is there a train to Ha Long?
faqs.a: Not as a visitor service to the harbor. The road is the way.
